title: Mecharachnid
description:
This was a very early experiment with **shaders**! I modelled a mechanical spider based on the one in Wild Wild West, and later a more simplified geometric version to play with in this demo scene.

![](assets/projects/college/mecharachnid/screenshot-4.png)These screenshots show various debug views, like lights, mesh normals, and depth maps. Everything you see was rendered from scratch (lighting, shadows, materials) by custom HLSL shaders.

![](assets/projects/college/mecharachnid/screenshot-2.png)Half the fun was playing with **inverse kinematics**, so you could control the spider with arrow keys, but the eight legs would move dynamically in response.

![](assets/projects/college/mecharachnid/screenshot-3.png)![](assets/projects/college/mecharachnid/screenshot-5.png)
